prompt:
Production asset authoring for the approved Human medieval fantasy football stadium. Input 1 is the EXACT pixel-art authority: materials, chunky connected pixels, mature faces, dark outlines, torch warmth. Input 2 is the accepted modular bowl composition. Create a TRANSPARENT original atlas, 4 equal columns by 5 equal rows, exactly 20 isolated unlabelled cells, spacious transparent gutters (at least 12% of each cell on all sides). No background, checkerboard painting, words, UI, field or full stadium scene. Every asset stays completely inside its own cell. Recommended canvas 1600x2000; use actual output dimensions consistently.

Reproduce the source's rich small-scale pixel-art; no smooth modern illustration or cute sparse full-body crowd groups. Architecture assets are straight unforeshortened front views suitable for applying the pitch camera exactly once. Top views are genuinely overhead, not front views rotated in the image. Low grey stone, heavy dark timber, blue/ivory cloth, small brass/iron fittings.

Cells in ROW-MAJOR order, four per row:
ROW 1:
1. Stone: square tile of small weathered grey-brown stone and worn standing-area ground, no people.
2. Timber: a straight HORIZONTAL repeating retaining-wall segment, several courses of grey stone blocks capped by a thick rounded timber rail, two dark timber uprights, small metal fittings. No torches or flags. Flat front elevation, 3:1 width/height. Natural dark edges suitable for repeating adjacent segments.
3. Gate: field-level wooden double-leaf locker-room doorway with stone/timber surround, dark recessed interior/planks, front elevation, isolated complete portal. Small original-style iron handles.
4. GateTop: overhead footprint of the same locker-room passage/threshold, flat top view.
ROW 2:
5. Crowd: a wide dense horizontal head-and-shoulder strip of Human spectators looking toward camera/down toward field. Approximately twelve varied human heads across and three staggered rows deep, shoulder to shoulder with overlapping torsos and almost no gaps. Dark hoods, muted blue/ivory, hair, varied ages, mostly at rest. No seats, ground, wall, banners or torches.
6. CrowdSide: same dense horizontal Human crowd strip, seen in three-quarter side profile looking to the RIGHT into the field. Same packed density and material, no props or architecture.
7. CrowdTop: square densely packed patch of overhead Human heads, hoods and shoulders, with almost no empty ground; genuinely seen from above.
8. Banner: hanging blue cloth with ivory original rough cross, simple gold edging, source-like.
ROW 3:
9. Bench: modest wooden player bench, straight front view, no people, a tiny ale cup beside it.
10. BenchTop: same bench viewed directly overhead.
11. Pavilion: small blue/ivory canvas sideline pavilion, front/three-quarter view, modest pole frame and open front, no people.
12. PavilionTop: same small pavilion viewed directly overhead, clear alternating roof cloth panels.
ROW 4:
13. Mugs: small cluster of wooden ale mug and empty cups, isolated.
14. Torch: timber/iron bracket and warm flaming torch like the original source, isolated.
15. TorchTop: genuine overhead small torch/bracket/brazier footprint with restrained flame.
16. Pennant: small blue/ivory cloth flag and timber pole, isolated.
ROW 5:
17. CrowdBack: dense wide horizontal crowd strip matching cell 5, but ONLY backs of Human heads, hair, hoods and shoulders, facing AWAY into field. No camera-facing faces. Same roughly twelve across and three deep, no gaps.
18. CrowdSideReverse: dense Human crowd in three-quarter side profile looking LEFT, matching cell 6.
19. FanRest: ONE Human fan, head and upper torso only, source-like dark hood/blue clothing, resting, front view, bottom-center anchor.
20. FanCheer: the EXACT SAME fan as cell 19, same head, face, torso, size and bottom-center alignment, with ONE raised fist and shouting expression. This is a gesture animation frame. No moved body or feet.

All crowd strips are a continuous packed mass, never isolated three-person groups. Fan pose cells remain separate from those strips. Maintain consistent lighting/pixel density across the entire sheet, broad transparent gutters, no labels. These are modular assets, not a mockup sheet with opaque panels.
regionMethod: Read-only connected alpha-component measurement of original output; per-asset transparent frames preserve pixels despite nonuniform rows/columns. No pixel cropping, resizing or background editing.
